about_the_game:
Monterey Jack with his cursed cheese dip brings everything they touch—dolls, mannequins, even factory machines—to life in horrifying, twisted forms. Play as high school junior Gordi and enter the abandoned Monterey Jack Cheese Factory in search of your missing friend Mikey.

PLAY THE DEMO, AND GET A TASTE OF TERROR!


Drip, drop, the dairy's near—Monterey Jack is what you fear!

Step into the decrepit Welcome Center—a sprawling, once-whimsical gateway to the Monterey Jack Cheese Factory. In this chilling first chapter, explore its abandoned halls, uncover early clues about the factory's dark past, and survive your first terrifying encounter with Monterey Jack himself. This is just the beginning...

COMPLETE THE FIRST CHAPTER OF MONTEREY JACK!


Get creative in defeating soft, liquid cheese-based enemies.

Play through 45 minutes of terrifying content in the Monterey Jack demo—featuring deadly enemies, unique items, and Jack’s relentless stalker A.I. If you enjoy the horror, don’t forget to wishlist the full game so you’re ready when it launches!

content_descriptors.notes: This game features a giant cheese man who chases the player. Many jumpscares to be had.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad core processor
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 or AMD RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
